name: rux-desktop-workbench
author: Rux
description: Rux desktop workbench for observable and controllable coding agents

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:tui
scripts.package: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:tui && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:tui && electron-builder
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:release-boundary && npm run test:models && npm run test:sessions && npm run test:handoff && npm run test:auth && npm run test:persistence && npm run test:agents && npm run test:adapters && npm run test:permissions && npm run test:context && npm run test:runtime-lifecycle && npm run test:runtime-host && npm run test:git && npm run test:sites && npm run test:tui
scripts.test:adapters: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/codex-event-parser.test.mjs tests/codex-adapter.test.mjs tests/codex-app-server-adapter.test.mjs tests/claude-adapter.test.mjs tests/claude-permission-broker.test.mjs tests/native-provider-adapter.test.mjs tests/native-provider-store.test.mjs
scripts.test:tui: cargo fmt --manifest-path ../tui/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path ../tui/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path ../tui/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
